title: narcissus assoanus subsp. rivas-martinezii
intro: Narcissus assoanus subsp. rivas-martinezii, commonly known as the Rivas Martinez's Daffodil, is a lesser-known subspecies of the Narcissus assoanus plant. This plant is a species of flowering bulbous perennial native to Spain. It has been used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from respiratory issues and inflammation due to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
